name: Antonin Jech
intro:
Senior Frontend Developer with a years long background spanning software engineering, UX/UI, digital agencies and real-world operational leadership outside tech.

Specialized in React (or Vue), TypeScript and GraphQL ecosystems, with strong backend overlap in Node.js, APIs and Neo4j. Combines engineering, UX thinking and product understanding to ship scalable frontend systems, while using AI tooling as a practical force multiplier for development and problem-solving.

Experienced with test automation, code reviews and translating complex business requirements into maintainable software. Brings a rare mix of engineering depth, visual thinking and adaptability shaped by years working across different industries and cultures.
